description: Remove a video from the style library. Its upload stays in media (media_delete removes it). Saved style profiles keep what they learned from it. Its study goes with it, so agents get a confirm_token step.

confirm_token.description: Token from a CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED response, sent after the user confirms.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

name: style_reference_delete
title: Delete a style reference
